info.title: Hanzo Cloud API
info.description: Generated from the live router — every operation below is a route the unified cloud binary actually serves. Tagged by product: the first path segment after /v1/.

get.summary:
adminList reads every author with its repo and deploy counts, plus a fleet tally of
accrued, pending and paid royalty.
get.description:
adminList reads every author with its repo and deploy counts, plus a fleet tally of
accrued, pending and paid royalty. SuperAdmin only.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description:
Limit caps the rows returned; absent or non-positive means 500, and nothing
above 1000 is honoured.

post.summary: adminSweep accrues this period's royalty for every approved author.
post.description:
adminSweep accrues this period's royalty for every approved author. It is the
operator's override of the scheduler's automatic pass.

The fold walks each approved author's DISTINCT deploying orgs and latches royalty
at-most-once per (author, org, period), so running it twice accrues nothing the
second time. A per-author failure is logged and skipped, never fatal. SuperAdmin
only.

post.summary:
adminApprove admits an author to earning, optionally overriding their royalty
share.
post.description:
adminApprove admits an author to earning, optionally overriding their royalty
share. SuperAdmin only.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID is the author id from the path.

get.summary: adminBasis reads one author's royalty basis.
get.description:
adminBasis reads one author's royalty basis. It runs the SAME builder the author's
own endpoint runs, so support sees exactly what the author sees. SuperAdmin only.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID is the author id from the path, as returned by the admin directory.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Period is the UTC year-month, e.g. "2026-07". Empty is every period.

post.summary: adminPayout records a payout of accrued royalty and settles it.
post.description:
adminPayout records a payout of accrued royalty and settles it. Both guards run
before any money moves.

A "credits" method issues a commerce grant into the author's wallet; a cash method
is record-only. The amount can never exceed pending (accrued − paid), reserved
atomically before any grant, and an external payout must additionally be backed by
the treasury reserve — an unbacked one is refused with 402 and the reservation
voided. SuperAdmin only.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID is the author id from the path.

post.summary: adminSuspend stops an author earning, leaving accrued royalty payable.
post.description:
adminSuspend stops an author earning, leaving accrued royalty payable. SuperAdmin
only.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID is the author id from the path, as returned by the admin directory.

get.summary: myAuthors reads the caller org's author dashboard.
get.description:
myAuthors reads the caller org's author dashboard. It answers status, login,
verified repos and owner claims, deploy edges, accrued/pending/paid royalty and
payout history.

An org that has not connected gets an honest {isAuthor:false} shape so the console
can show the connect form — not a 404, which would answer "is this org an author?".
For an APPROVED author it ALSO opportunistically runs the accrual sweep, so the
dashboard is self-updating; a commerce hiccup never fails the page.

The response is the open dashboard document, not a fixed record: the enrolled and
not-enrolled answers carry different keys, so no single struct states it truthfully.

get.summary: basis reads the audit trail behind the caller's OWN royalty.
get.description:
basis reads the audit trail behind the caller's OWN royalty. It answers the current
cost model, the immutable ledger rows with the attribution edges that explain each,
an account-wide reconciliation, and an honest statement of the slice returned.

The subject is the principal's org, so no id can be supplied. It is a separate
endpoint from the dashboard precisely because the dashboard accrues lazily on read:
an audit must not move the money it is auditing, so this path never sweeps and
calling it N times leaves the balances and the ledger byte-identical. An org that
is not an author gets {isAuthor:false}, not a 404, which would answer "is this org
an author?".

The response is the open basis document, not a fixed record: the enrolled and
not-enrolled answers carry different keys, and the model, reconciliation and window
sections grow with the disclosure.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description:
Period is the UTC year-month the accrual latch mints, e.g. "2026-07". Empty is
every period; any other shape is refused.

post.summary: connect enrolls the caller's org as an author.
post.description:
connect enrolls the caller's org as an author. It answers the verify material an
author places on their default branch, and is idempotent — a repeat connect returns
the existing author with created:false.

The login comes from IAM's linked forge account when there is one (identity
verified), else from the supplied login, which is verified later per repo. The
response is 201 on the call that enrolled the org and 200 on a repeat.

post.summary: recordDeploy records a deploy-attribution edge for the caller's DEPLOYING org.
post.description:
recordDeploy records a deploy-attribution edge for the caller's DEPLOYING org. It
is what makes a deploy earn its author royalty.

When repoUrl names a VERIFIED author repo — or a repo under a verified owner — the
edge is recorded (idempotent per repo+project+org) and becomes eligible for royalty.
A repo that is not a verified author repo is NOT an error: it answers recorded:false
so the deploy path can fire this unconditionally. A self-deploy is recorded for
provenance but excluded from accrual. 201 on the call that wrote the edge.

post.summary: verifyRepo proves the caller owns a repo or a whole owner.
post.description:
verifyRepo proves the caller owns a repo or a whole owner. Both are proven the same
two ways, and both record a claim.

A repo url records a per-repo claim; an owner url records an owner-wide claim
covering every repo under that owner. Ownership is proven the SAME two ways in both
cases: an IAM-linked forge token with admin/push permission, or a hanzo.json
carrying the author's verify code on the default branch (for an owner, of its
.github control repo). Unprovable ownership is 422, a claim another author already
holds is 409, and the caller must have connected first. 201 on the call that
recorded the claim, 200 on a repeat.

approvedAt.description: ApprovedAt is unix seconds when the author was admitted to earning; 0 if never.

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is unix seconds when the org connected.

deployCount.description:
DeployCount is how many attribution edges point at this author. 0 on the
single-author answers, which do not count.

githubLogin.description: GithubLogin is the linked forge login.

org.description: Org is the author's own org, exposed here and nowhere on the customer surface.

paidCents.description: PaidCents is lifetime royalty paid out.

pendingCents.description: PendingCents is accrued minus paid, never negative.

repoCount.description:
RepoCount is how many repos this author has claimed. 0 on the single-author
answers, which do not count.

shareBps.description: ShareBps is the author's royalty share in basis points.

status.description: Status is connected, approved or suspended.

suspendedAt.description: SuspendedAt is unix seconds when the author was suspended; 0 if never.

verified.description: Verified reports an IAM-linked forge identity rather than file-only proof.

id.description: ID is the author id from the path.

shareBps.description:
ShareBps overrides the author's royalty share, in basis points (0–10000). 0
keeps the current share.

data.description: Data is the SAME open basis document the author's own endpoint returns.

created.description:
Created is true when THIS call recorded the claim; false when it already
existed.

org.description:
Owner is the owner-wide claim covering every repo under that owner, present
when the url named an owner. It is serialized as "org".

repo.description: Repo is the per-repo claim, present when the url named a repo.

githubLogin.description:
GithubLogin is the login to link when IAM holds no linked account for the
provider. Ignored when one is linked — that identity is stronger proof.

login.description:
Login is the provider-neutral alias for GithubLogin, and wins when both are
sent.

provider.description: Provider is the forge to link: "github" or "gitlab". Empty means github.

project.description: Project is the deployed project's id. Required.

repoUrl.description:
RepoURL is the forge repo the project was sourced from. Empty means a
hand-built project with nothing to attribute.

created.description:
Created is true when THIS call wrote the edge, false when it already existed.
Present only on a recorded:true answer.

createdAt.description:
CreatedAt is unix seconds when the edge was first written, on a recorded:true
answer only.

deployId.description: DeployID is the attribution edge's id, on a recorded:true answer only.

reason.description: Reason says why nothing was attributed, on a recorded:false answer only.

recorded.description:
Recorded reports whether an attribution edge exists for this deploy. False is
an honest no-op, not an error, so a deploy path can fire this unconditionally.

self.description:
Self reports a deploy of the author's own repo by the author's own org —
recorded for provenance, excluded from accrual by the sweep. Present only on a
recorded:true answer.

authors.description: Authors is one row per author, org exposed. Never null.

created.description: Created is true when THIS call enrolled the org; false on a repeat connect.

githubLogin.description: GithubLogin is the linked forge login, lower-cased.

id.description: ID is the author id, stable across repeat connects.

shareBps.description: ShareBps is the author's royalty share in basis points.

status.description: Status is the author's lifecycle state — "connected" on first link.

verified.description:
Verified reports an IAM-linked forge identity (strong proof) rather than a
login the caller merely typed.

verifyCode.description: VerifyCode is this author's stable code for the file method.

verifyFile.description: VerifyFile is the file name to place on the default branch: "hanzo.json".

verifySnippet.description: VerifySnippet is the ready-to-paste hanzo.json body carrying the code.

data.description: Data carries the author as it now stands.

author.description: Author is the author after the change.

badgeMarkdown.description:
BadgeMarkdown is the ready-to-paste badge deep-linking this owner's template
import.

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is unix seconds when the claim was first recorded.

method.description:
Method is how it was proven: "oauth" or "file", against the owner's .github
control repo.

ownerUrl.description: OwnerURL is the canonical "host/owner" form, unique across authors.

verified.description: Verified reports that ownership of the owner was proven.

verifiedAt.description: VerifiedAt is unix seconds when ownership was proven.

author.description: Author is the author after the payout reserved against pending.

data.description: Data carries the payout row and the author after it.

amountCents.description:
AmountCents is the payout, in USD minor units. Must be positive and can never
exceed the author's pending royalty.

id.description: ID is the author id from the path.

method.description:
Method is "credits" (issues a commerce grant into the author's wallet) or a
cash method such as wire or paypal (record-only). Required.

reference.description: Reference is the operator's own note or external transfer id.

amountCents.description: AmountCents is the disbursement, in USD minor units.

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is unix seconds when the payout was reserved.

method.description: Method is "credits" or a cash method such as wire or paypal.

reference.description: Reference is the operator's note or external transfer id.

settlement.description:
Settlement discloses treasury-vs-wallet-vs-cash on every payout, to the author
and to the admin mirror alike — the disclosure that keeps a first-party
settlement legible as internal accounting.

txn.description: Txn is the commerce grant or treasury entry id, when one was issued.

id.description: ID is the author id from the path, as returned by the admin directory.

badgeMarkdown.description: BadgeMarkdown is the ready-to-paste "Deploy on Hanzo" README snippet.

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is unix seconds when the claim was first recorded.

method.description:
Method is how it was proven: "oauth" (admin/push on the repo) or "file"
(hanzo.json carrying the verify code).

verified.description: Verified reports that ownership was proven.

verifiedAt.description: VerifiedAt is unix seconds when ownership was proven.

accruedCents.description: AccruedCents, PendingCents and PaidCents sum the rows returned.

connected.description: Connected, Approved and Suspended count them by status.

total.description: Total is how many authors the listing returned.

accrued.description: Accrued is how many royalty ledger rows THIS pass latched.

swept.description: Swept is how many (author, deploying org) pairs were checked.

data.description: Data is what the fold did.

repoUrl.description:
RepoURL is a forge repo (github.com/owner/name) or a whole owner
(github.com/owner). gitlab.com is accepted in both forms. Required.
